summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting that underwriters exercised in full their option to purchase an additional 1,500,000 ordinary shares in its public offering, generating $30.0 million in gross proceeds. No specific price per share is mentioned beyond the aggregate. This is a routine secondary offering closing; there is no merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or activist event. The transaction is simply a capital raise via an underwritten public offering that has already closed. No further special-situation mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
